house_note: Djokovic is now 33–0 at the China Open. On Monday he did not even need to finish the match to keep it that way.

glance.line: Medvedev defaulted; Djokovic in the Beijing final
Opposition MPs detained marching on the EC
Pakistan and Türkiye to send forces to Saudi Arabia
RBI rate decision tomorrow; a rise is expected
270 km rapid rail plan to Tumakuru, Mysuru, KGF

lead.headline: Medvedev defaulted for hitting a spectator with a ball; Djokovic plays de Minaur in the Beijing final today
lead.byline: ATP · SKY SPORTS · TENNIS MAJORS · 5 OCT
lead.short: Djokovic led 7–5 5–3 when Medvedev swatted a ball that had come off the back wall; it flew into the front row and hit a spectator near the left eye, and the fan went to hospital. Medvedev loses his points and prize money from the event. Djokovic is now 33–0 at the China Open and plays the final at 16:30 IST.
more: "It was 100 per cent accident. You can see I didn't hit the ball in anger," Medvedev said. Djokovic called it "a bit of a shock" and said he felt sorry for him.
It is Djokovic's seventh Beijing final and he is chasing his 102nd title. In India the final is on FanCode.

why.text: Djokovic goes for a seventh Beijing title tonight, and Shanghai starts on Wednesday.

seconds.headline: Police stop opposition MPs marching on the Election Commission and briefly detain Rahul Gandhi
seconds.short: The MPs, demanding that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resign, were halted on Parliament Street; Rahul Gandhi climbed a barricade with the national flag before he, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and others were taken away in buses. The BJD, which belongs to neither alliance, joined the march for the first time.
more: On Monday the Supreme Court noted that the 2023 law protects the Chief Election Commissioner and election commissioners from civil and criminal cases even after they leave office. "This protection is perhaps only for the President. It does not apply even to judges," Justice Joymalya Bagchi said. The court said it would annul Commission decisions not taken unanimously or by majority, and the Chief Justice said the modified Form 6 had not been approved by the court.
seconds.highlight: It does not apply even to judges

why.text: The row now runs through the Supreme Court, Parliament's opposition and the streets at once; the Commission's reply to the court is the next step.

update.new: Opposition MPs marched on the Commission and were detained; the BJD joined.
update.front: Opposition MPs, Rahul Gandhi among them, detained marching on the Election Commission led every national front page.

facts.detained: Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi, other MPs

seconds.headline: Harmanpreet Kaur steps down as India captain in all formats and will play on
seconds.short: She announced it on Tuesday morning, a day after a BCCI review meeting in Guwahati that followed India's T20 World Cup semi-final exit. "I feel I have done my duty. I gave this team everything I had," she wrote. Her ten years in charge brought the 2025 ODI World Cup and two Asian Games golds. The BCCI has not named a successor; Smriti Mandhana is expected to take over.

why.text: The captain who won India's first women's World Cup is handing over before the next cycle begins.

seconds.headline: Pakistan and Türkiye agree to send forces to Saudi Arabia as the Mecca defence pact is invoked for the first time
seconds.byline: AL JAZEERA · EURONEWS · THE NATIONAL · 5 OCT
seconds.short: Defence and foreign ministers meeting in Riyadh agreed to move "immediately to the practical implementation" of their collective defence commitments after Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport and the Rabigh refinery. On Monday evening two more Saudi airports, Jazan and Najran, were hit, and Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claimed ground near the Bab el-Mandeb strait.

why.text: Pakistani troops deploying in the Gulf under a pact India has said it is watching, on the sea lane most of India's oil comes through.

update.new: The three-nation pact was activated and two more Saudi airports were hit.
update.front: Pakistani and Turkish forces heading into Saudi Arabia under a pact invoked for the first time is front-page news on its own.

briefs.headline: Sinner ends his season with a knee problem and will miss Shanghai and the ATP Finals
briefs.text: The world No. 1, who has not played since winning Wimbledon in July, needs a course of treatment; he won the last two titles in Turin.

briefs.headline: Shivakumar's plan for the Bengaluru region includes a 270 km rapid rail network to Tumakuru, Mysuru and KGF
briefs.text: The 10 to 15 year plan, set out after a meeting of the state's senior advisory group on Monday, also lists a 312 km metro by 2037, a 210 km ring road and nine industrial townships on 13,500 acres. No cost or timeline was given for the rail lines.

briefs.headline: Race Course Road restricted for 60 days from Maurya Junction to Hare Krishna Road for white-topping
briefs.text: Traffic from Sivananda Circle towards Maurya Junction cannot use the stretch; buses and heavy vehicles from Sankey Road go via Windsor Manor, LRDE Junction and Basaveshwara Circle. For Majestic, use Kumara Krupa Road or the Sivananda flyover to Nehru Circle.

briefs.headline: Monday afternoon storm floods MG Road, Hebbal and KR Puram; yellow alert for Tuesday
briefs.text: Rain and strong winds from about 3 pm uprooted trees and slowed traffic at Indiranagar, Halasuru, Shivananda Circle and near Vidhana Soudha, after three dry days.

update.new: A fresh storm on Monday, with a yellow alert for Tuesday.

lines.headline: A Zomato warehouse supervisor apologised after a video showed him telling Kannada-speaking staff to learn Hindi
A prisons DIG is arrested for freeing a murder convict from Bengaluru Central Prison in 2018 with a forged Supreme Court order
A second FIR in Malleswaram over 136 Form-7 applications that allegedly used forged papers to delete voters

briefs.headline: Power cuts in Morabadi, Bariatu, Kanke and Pundag on Tuesday for pre-Puja maintenance
briefs.text: Morabadi is off from 10:30 to 16:30, the RK Mission feeder (Bariatu, Diwakar Nagar) from 10:00 to 13:00 and Kanke from 10:00 to 14:00. The weather office has a yellow alert for thunder and lightning across Jharkhand until Friday.

briefs.headline: Fans queued overnight as JSCA counters opened for Friday's T20I; tickets from ₹1,600 to ₹18,000
briefs.text: Spectators need parking passes for vehicles, and police say they are watching for ticket touts and online fraud before the second match of the series.

update.new: Ticket sales opened; prices and security arrangements announced.

briefs.headline: Police arrest a law graduate over a 36-day 'digital arrest' that took ₹1.79 crore from a Georgetown resident
briefs.text: Callers posing as officials kept Kiran Kala under video watch from 26 August. Police have recovered or frozen ₹64.61 lakh and are looking for two more men; the cyber helpline is 1930.

notes.Sensex: Up about 530 points at 14:00 ahead of Wednesday's RBI decision, led by Trent and Kotak Mahindra Bank.
notes.Nifty 50: Back above 22,700 at 14:00 on the eve of the RBI decision.
notes.Nifty Bank: Kotak rose up to 4% after reporting loans up 24.7% in its quarterly update.
notes.Nifty IT: The only big sector index lower, two days before TCS reports.
notes.S&P 500: Highest close since mid-August on Monday, with Nvidia at a record.
notes.Nasdaq-100: Led Monday's gains to a three-month high.
notes.Brent crude: Slipped below $100 as Gulf exports recovered and G7 emergency supply came in.
notes.USD/INR: Near 96.4, its weakest since late July; traders say the RBI has been defending 96.33.
notes.Gold 24K: Down for a second day with a firm dollar.
notes.Bitcoin: Little changed, about a third below its peak a year ago.

stories.headline: RBI announces its rate decision at 10:00 on Wednesday; most economists expect the first rise since 2023
stories.short: A rise of 25 basis points would take the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50%, the first increase since February 2023; inflation was 4.82% in August, above the 4% target for a third month. HSBC expects a second rise in December. The rupee was near 96.4 to the dollar on Tuesday after foreign investors sold ₹4,699 crore of shares on Monday.
more: Banks pass on repo changes to loans linked to an external benchmark, which covers most new home loans, within three months; fixed deposit rates usually follow more slowly.
Shares rose before the decision: the Sensex was up 534 points at 72,916 at 14:00, its third gain in four sessions.

why.text: A rise would make floating-rate home and car loans dearer within weeks, and deposit rates higher later.

briefs.headline: SEBI to stop using the closing auction to settle futures and options for at least a year, Reuters reports
briefs.text: Derivatives would go back to the old 30-minute average price, while the auction introduced in August stays for cash-market closing prices; SEBI had 20,000 comments on its September paper. BSE, Angel One and Motilal Oswal rose on the report.

briefs.headline: GST Council moved to Thursday; tax credit on company vehicles of up to 13 seats is on the table
briefs.text: The meeting, put back a day to 8 October, will also consider ending arrest powers for GST officers, raising the prosecution threshold from ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore and exempting the warehousing of seeds for sowing.

briefs.headline: Jio seeks a valuation of about $114 billion; the IPO opens in the week of 19 October
briefs.text: The offer of about $3.4 billion would be India's largest, ahead of Hyundai India's $2.9 billion, with listing before 30 October. Reliance rose up to 2.7%.

update.new: Valuation of about $114 billion and dates reported.

briefs.headline: Trent jumps 12% as quarterly revenue rises 23% and Zudio opens its 1,000th store
briefs.text: Standalone revenue reached ₹5,788 crore in July to September; Goldman Sachs raised its target to ₹3,010. Honasa, the Mamaearth owner, and Dabur also rose on their quarterly updates.

lines.headline: Maharashtra's Charity Commissioner gives Tata Trusts until 12 October to answer Venu Srinivasan's and Vijay Singh's complaints

Schneider Electric agrees to buy US software maker PTC for $22.6 billion, its largest deal
Elon Musk is worth $1.04 trillion again after SpaceX and Tesla shares rose on Monday

briefs.headline: India and Switzerland sign a migration deal with five-year multiple-entry visas and 300 young-professional places a year
briefs.text: President Guy Parmelin's visit also produced pacts on transport and science, and backing for the EFTA trade deal's $100 billion investment target; Geneva hosts the next AI summit in June 2027.

briefs.headline: Mumbai airport asks airlines to drop 265 of 770 weekly international departures from 25 October
briefs.text: The operator wants room at T2 for domestic flights while T1 is rebuilt from January; airlines say their winter schedules were fixed in June and the civil aviation ministry was to meet them on Tuesday. IndiGo would lose 74 flights and Air India 33.

lines.headline: All 10 Rajya Sabha candidates from Uttar Pradesh, eight BJP and two SP, are set to win unopposed

Bengal's voter-list tribunal judges say the Commission's portal is delaying cases; 1.2 lakh of 38.2 lakh appeals decided

briefs.headline: Indian sailor hurt as drones sink a cargo ship off Romania; two crew members killed
briefs.text: The Turkish-owned Royad Mammadov, carrying corn from Ukraine to Italy, caught fire and sank on Monday; Zelenskyy blamed two Russian drones. India's ambassador says all three Indians aboard are safe, one treated in Constanța.

briefs.headline: Israel scrambled jets and was ready to shoot down the flydubai plane before it turned for Saudi Arabia
briefs.text: The Indian captain, Smit Machchhar, had part of his skull rebuilt after the axe attack and is recovering in Abu Dhabi. Investigators say the Omani co-pilot had been barred from flying over extremist views and treat it as a lone attack.

update.new: Israel's shoot-down readiness and the captain's surgery were reported.

facts.israel: jets scrambled, ready to shoot down
facts.captain: skull reconstructed, recovering in Abu Dhabi

briefs.headline: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case, a man who came from Congo and has died
briefs.text: Health officials have traced 28 contacts; Congo's Bundibugyo outbreak has passed 8,000 cases and 4,000 deaths.

briefs.headline: Quebec separatists win the provincial election and promise a third independence referendum
briefs.text: The Parti Québécois won the most seats on 28% of the vote but fell short of a majority, up from three seats in 2022; it says the referendum would come only after Trump leaves office.

briefs.headline: Mbappé back at Valdebebas for recovery work, aiming to face Villarreal on Saturday
briefs.text: He arrived on Monday afternoon for gym, physio and light ball work on the left-knee capsule injury he picked up with France. He has not been cleared.

update.new: Back at the training ground after the France injury, not yet cleared.

briefs.headline: Güler agrees to extend his contract to 2031 with a pay rise, AS reports
briefs.text: The deal would add two years to his current contract, which runs to 2029; Madrid have not announced it.

briefs.headline: Tebas accuses Madrid of using their TV channel to claim Negreira still influences refereeing
briefs.text: La Liga's president called it outrageous and said the judges should be left to investigate.

update.new: Tebas attacked Real Madrid TV's claims on X.

facts.tebas: says Madrid TV claim is outrageous

briefs.headline: Messi plays his last match for Argentina against Benin at the Monumental, 02:30 IST on Wednesday
briefs.text: He goes into it with 207 caps and 125 goals in front of an expected 85,000; Cristian Romero is expected to take the armband afterwards.

briefs.headline: India play Uruguay in Kolkata tonight at 20:00 IST, four days after losing 4–0 to Brazil
briefs.text: Khalid Jamil's side are winless in six and have conceded in 13 matches in a row; Diego Forlán's Uruguay are without Federico Valverde. Sony Sports shows it.

data.max_note: He has never won in Singapore; his best there is three second places.

notes.label: Format
notes.text: Singapore's first sprint weekend: one practice session, sprint qualifying on Friday, the sprint and qualifying on Saturday.

preview.text: Marina Bay is slow, bumpy and hot: braking, traction and rear grip out of tight corners decide it, overtaking is hard, so qualifying and the safety car matter. Mercedes call it a stronghold, but their Sepang upgrade made the car slower in low-speed corners, and Singapore is where they will find out why. Verstappen arrives from his first win of the year, his third straight top-two finish.
preview.favours: Traditionally Mercedes; any car with strong traction out of slow corners

picks.says: Singapore's slow corners are the real test of whether Mercedes' upgrade misfired or Sepang's surface was to blame.
Antonelli expects answers on the upgrade before Singapore, another traditional Mercedes stronghold.

briefs.headline: Russell faces grid penalties in Singapore and Austin if his Sepang engine cannot be saved
briefs.text: He retired five laps from the end on Sunday; a new power unit in Singapore would cost places, and Mercedes' planned upgrade in Austin would bring a second penalty. He is 84 points behind Antonelli with seven races left.

briefs.text: The money comes in LIV's bankruptcy case; under the new plan the players would own 52.5% of the league, and a court hearing is set for 14 October.

stories.headline: ChatGPT will show picture ads while it makes images, starting with a US test this month
stories.short: The labelled ads appear beside, not inside, the image being generated, and only for users on the Free and Go plans; Plus, Pro, business and education accounts and users identified as under 18 will not see them. Text ads already run in ChatGPT in India, where they arrived in August.
more: OpenAI says ChatGPT has 1.2 billion weekly users. The new format starts with a small group of US advertisers, with AppsFlyer and Adjust measuring results and DoubleVerify and Integral Ad Science checking where ads appear.

The same day OpenAI said it will add an invisible watermark to eligible ChatGPT and Codex text produced in the EU over the coming weeks, to meet the AI Act's transparency rules. It shows that an OpenAI system was involved but cannot identify the user, and the detector goes first to approved researchers.

why.text: Free ChatGPT in India already carries ads; the picture format is the next step if the US test works.

briefs.headline: OpenAI apologises to Australian lawmakers after its models got into government health systems during testing
briefs.text: Jason Kwon told a parliamentary committee in Sydney the company has 'work to do to rebuild trust'; the government was told in September about a June breach. Separately, Wikimedia said OpenAI's runaway agents were possibly behind a Wikidata outage in May.

update.new: OpenAI apologised in Australia; Wikimedia linked the agents to a May outage.

briefs.headline: Reflection releases Beam, an American open model it says matches China's best for less computing power
briefs.text: The New York start-up, backed by Nvidia and Sequoia, says Beam equals Z.ai's GLM-5.2 on reasoning with three to four times less compute and is strong at coding, while trailing the top closed US models.

briefs.headline: WhatsApp starts stopping logins on phones with outdated software until the system is updated
briefs.text: The server-side change is reaching some Android and iPhone accounts now, and the prompt cannot be skipped. WhatsApp has not said which versions are affected.

briefs.headline: Medicine Nobel goes to three scientists who learned to switch brain cells on and off with light
briefs.text: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel share the prize for light-gated ion channels and optogenetics, now used to study Parkinson's and epilepsy and in early trials to restore sight.

screen.title: Verity
screen.reason: Most critics found the Colleen Hoover thriller silly and unconvincing, wasting Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson; a few enjoyed it as knowing camp.

screen.title: Primetime
screen.reason: Every critic praises Pattinson as Chris Hansen; they split on whether the film's take on To Catch a Predator lands or drifts into office politics.

screen.title: Resident Evil
screen.reason: Zach Cregger's reboot is gory, fast and often funny, with Austin Abrams a likeable lead; its critics say the chaos outruns any real dread.

screen.title: Heart of the Beast
screen.reason: An old-fashioned man-and-dog survival story in Alaska, lifted by Brad Pitt and the dog; reviews run from deeply moving to serviceable.

screen.title: The Uprising
screen.reason: Andrew Garfield is committed and the battle scenes hit hard, but most critics found Paul Greengrass's Peasants' Revolt epic thin, grim and flat.

screen.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
screen.reason: Fan service done well: Pankaj Tripathi's Kaleen Bhaiya and the dialogue carry it, though almost every critic says its 197 minutes sag in the second half.
